title: Add deterministic TUI refresh and event model
purpose: Make TUI updates predictable by rebuilding snapshots from authoritative runtime state after commands and refresh events.
scope: Define refresh triggers for command completion, timer tick and explicit refresh.
Rebuild snapshots from RunStore, AuditJournal and projection sources.
Avoid mutable render cache as authoritative state.
Render transient errors separately from durable run state.
Support deterministic replay with fixed fixture clocks where needed.
acceptance_criteria: Refresh cannot mask failed-closed, rollback-pending or approval-pending state.
Repeated refresh with unchanged sources produces identical output.
Transient command errors do not mutate durable run state.
failure_modes: Render cache becomes source of truth.
Transient error state overwrites run status.
